pinterest.title: Corfu Wedding Venues on the Kommeno Peninsula: Sea Views and the Old Town
pinterest.description: The Kommeno peninsula, just north of Corfu Town, gives you every scale of wedding. Corfu Imperial hosts weddings and vow renewals on the Yali deck above the water, at Aristos or on its private islet Nissaki, for up to 50 guests, with views of the sea and the Old Town. Eva Palace offers an intimate beach ceremony, and Rodostamo frames its weddings against the Church of Ipapanti. Compare 10 Corfu wedding venues with sea views.

pinterest.title: Corfu Wedding Venues on the South-East Coast: A Resort or a Private Estate
pinterest.description: South of Corfu Town, the choice is clear. Angsana Corfu lists two outdoor symbolic ceremony venues: Vertigo Sky Bar for up to 250 from mid-May to the end of September, and Oribu Garden for up to 30 from April to October. The Courti Estate is a gated hilltop estate in ancient olive groves with nine bedrooms, available for private hire. Ask how a legal ceremony fits around a symbolic venue. Compare 10 Corfu wedding venues.

pinterest.title: West Coast Corfu Wedding Venues: Cliffside Ionian Views at Ermones
pinterest.description: Atlantica Grand Mediterraneo overlooks Ermones Beach in western Corfu, among cypress and pine woods, about 25 minutes from the airport and town. Its enquiry form lists legal, symbolic, vow renewal and same-sex ceremonies, and it hosts only one wedding on the day you choose. The Secret Garden suits the couple and up to eight guests. Plan to arrive at least three working days before the wedding. Compare 10 Corfu wedding venues.

slides: 10 Corfu wedding venues with sea views. Pick the coast before the venue: it decides the view behind your vows and how far guests travel.
Kommeno: four venues on one peninsula north of Corfu Town. Corfu Imperial looks across the sea to the Old Town, with a private islet, Nissaki, for up to 50 guests.
Corfu Town and Kanoni: the largest published capacities on the list. Corfu Holiday Palace has two ballrooms for a guest list in the hundreds, with an indoor fallback built in.
Kalami and the north-east: San Antonio is an adults-only resort among ancient olive groves on Kalami Bay, hosting weddings and vow renewals on its sun-kissed terraces.
Benitses and the south-east: Angsana Corfu's Vertigo Sky Bar takes up to 250 for a symbolic ceremony, while The Courti Estate is a gated estate for private hire.
Ermones and the west coast: Atlantica Grand Mediterraneo has cliffside views of the Ionian, lists legal and symbolic ceremonies, and hosts one wedding per day.
Exclusive use means different things. At The Courti Estate it is the whole estate. At Atlantica it is one wedding on your day. Ask every venue which one it means.
Curfews, minimum nights and rain plans are rarely published. Tell us your date, guest count and shortlist, and a Wedded Advisor will confirm them in writing. Link in bio.
instagram_carousel.caption:
Which Corfu wedding venues suit your guest list?

Corfu's sea views split by coast. The east looks across a calm strait to the mainland, with Corfu Town and the airport close by. The west has cliffside views of the open Ionian.

Our new guide sets out 10 venues across five areas, from the Kommeno peninsula and Corfu Town to Kalami, the south-east coast and Ermones, with the same details for every one: sea view setting, ceremony options, largest published capacity, rooms and exclusive use.

The short version: decide early whether your ceremony in Corfu will be your legal marriage or a symbolic one, because some venues list only symbolic ceremony spaces. Check which spaces are open on your date, as some run a shorter season. For a summer date, plan shade, a later start and a covered fallback. And ask each venue whether exclusive use means the whole property or one wedding on your day.

Shortlisting Corfu venues for your own wedding? Send us a message with your date, guest count and the venues you have in mind, and a Wedded Advisor will help you compare them. Your advisor works in your time zone, quotes in AUD and confirms every inclusion in writing before you commit. Full guide at the link in our bio.
